## Checking Accounts

Choose the [checking account][52] that works best for you. See our [Chase Total Checking^{®}][53]
offer for new customers. Make purchases with your debit card, and bank from almost anywhere by
phone, tablet or computer and more than 14,000 ATMs and 5,000 branches.

## Savings Accounts & CDs

It’s never too early to begin saving. [Open a savings account][54] or open a Certificate of Deposit
([see interest rates][55]) and start saving your money.

## Credit Cards

Chase [credit cards][56] can help you buy the things you need. Many of our cards [offer rewards][57]
that can be redeemed for [cash back][58] or [travel-related][59] perks. With so many options, it can
be easy to find a card that matches your lifestyle. Plus, with Credit Journey you can get a [free
credit score][60]!

## Mortgages

Apply for a [mortgage][61] or [refinance your mortgage][62] with Chase. View today’s [mortgage
rates][63] or calculate what you can afford with our [mortgage calculator][64]. Visit our [Education
Center][65] for homebuying tips and more.

## Auto

[Chase Auto][66] is here to help you get the right car. Apply for [auto financing][67] for a new or
used car with Chase. Use the [payment calculator][68] to estimate monthly payments. Check out the
[Chase Auto Education Center][69] to get car guidance from a trusted source.

## Chase for Business

With [Chase for Business][70] you’ll receive all-in-one services and guidance from a team of
business professionals. Explore [business checking][71], simplify payments acceptance with [merchant
services][72], and consider [small business loans][73] or [business credit cards][74] for help with
growth. You can also visit our [business resource center][75].

## Sports & Entertainment

Chase gives you access to unique sports, entertainment and culinary events through [Chase
Experiences][76] and our exclusive partnerships such as the [US Open][77], [Madison Square
Garden][78] and [Chase Center][79].

## Chase Security Center

Our [suite of security features][80] can [help you protect][81] your info, money and give you peace
of mind. See how we're dedicated to helping [protect you][82], your accounts and your loved ones
from [financial abuse][83]. Also, [learn about the common tricks scammers are using][84] to help you
stay one step ahead of them. If you see unauthorized charges or believe your account was compromised
contact us right away to [report fraud][85].

## About Chase

Chase serves millions of people with a broad range of products. [Chase online][86] lets you manage
your Chase accounts, view statements, monitor activity, pay bills or transfer funds securely from
one central place. To learn more, visit the [Banking Education Center][87]. For questions or
concerns, please contact [Chase customer service][88] or let us know about [Chase complaints and
feedback][89]. View the [Chase Community Reinvestment Act Public File][90] for the bank’s latest CRA
rating and other CRA-related information.

## Investing by J.P. Morgan

## Checking Accounts

Choose the [checking account][52] that works best for you. See our [Chase Total Checking^{®}][53]
offer for new customers. Make purchases with your debit card, and bank from almost anywhere by
phone, tablet or computer and more than 14,000 ATMs and 5,000 branches.

## Savings Accounts & CDs

It’s never too early to begin saving. [Open a savings account][54] or open a Certificate of Deposit
([see interest rates][55]) and start saving your money.

## Credit Cards

Chase [credit cards][56] can help you buy the things you need. Many of our cards [offer rewards][57]
that can be redeemed for [cash back][58] or [travel-related][59] perks. With so many options, it can
be easy to find a card that matches your lifestyle. Plus, with Credit Journey you can get a [free
credit score][60]!

## Mortgages

Apply for a [mortgage][61] or [refinance your mortgage][62] with Chase. View today’s [mortgage
rates][63] or calculate what you can afford with our [mortgage calculator][64]. Visit our [Education
Center][65] for homebuying tips and more.

## Auto

[Chase Auto][66] is here to help you get the right car. Apply for [auto financing][67] for a new or
used car with Chase. Use the [payment calculator][68] to estimate monthly payments. Check out the
[Chase Auto Education Center][69] to get car guidance from a trusted source.

## Chase for Business

With [Chase for Business][70] you’ll receive all-in-one services and guidance from a team of
business professionals. Explore [business checking][71], simplify payments acceptance with [merchant
services][72], and consider [small business loans][73] or [business credit cards][74] for help with
growth. You can also visit our [business resource center][75].

## Sports & Entertainment

Chase gives you access to unique sports, entertainment and culinary events through [Chase
Experiences][76] and our exclusive partnerships such as the [US Open][77], [Madison Square
Garden][78] and [Chase Center][79].

## Chase Security Center

Our [suite of security features][80] can [help you protect][81] your info, money and give you peace
of mind. See how we're dedicated to helping [protect you][82], your accounts and your loved ones
from [financial abuse][83]. Also, [learn about the common tricks scammers are using][84] to help you
stay one step ahead of them. If you see unauthorized charges or believe your account was compromised
contact us right away to [report fraud][85].

## About Chase

Chase serves millions of people with a broad range of products. [Chase online][86] lets you manage
your Chase accounts, view statements, monitor activity, pay bills or transfer funds securely from
one central place. To learn more, visit the [Banking Education Center][87]. For questions or
concerns, please contact [Chase customer service][88] or let us know about [Chase complaints and
feedback][89]. View the [Chase Community Reinvestment Act Public File][90] for the bank’s latest CRA
rating and other CRA-related information.

Partner with a global leader who puts your financial needs first. [Invest on your own][91] or [work

# Celebrating 25 Years of AsiaPay’s Digital Payment Journey

From a bold vision in 2000 to becoming a leading digital payment gateway across Asia. More than
payments, we’ve been a trusted growth partner to thousands of businesses. Thank you to our valued
merchants, partners and AsiaPayers for making this success possible!

Clients
Partners
Team

# Overview

AsiaPay supports merchants to accept digital payments by credit/debit cards, bank
accounts/netbanking, digital wallets, buy now pay later, over-the-counter and more in one single
platform.




# Channel Capabilities

Allow your consumers to make payments in the ways that most convenient to them




# Overview

AsiaPay supports merchants to accept digital payments by credit/debit cards, bank
accounts/netbanking, digital wallets, buy now pay later, over-the-counter and more in one single
platform.




# Channel Capabilities

Allow your consumers to make payments in the ways that most convenient to them




# About AsiaPay

Founded in 2000, AsiaPay is a premier digital payment solution and technology vendor in Asia,
strives to bring advanced, integrated, and cost-effective digital payment processing solutions and
services to banks and e-businesses around the world. Our integrated payment services covers credit
and debit cards, bank account/net banking, digital wallets, buy now pay later, over-the-counters and
other digital means.

AsiaPay offers a variety of award-winning, multi-currency, multi-lingual, multi-card, and
multi-channelled payment solutions, bundled with our advanced functionalities including fraud
detection, tokenisation, data analytic…etc.

Headquartered in Hong Kong, we offer professional digital payment services and solutions with
quality local accounts and technical services across 17 operation offices in Asia-Pacific.

## Our Vision

We provide corporate entities with the latest digital payment values that readily maximize your
business' efficiency, productivity, and global opportunities.


## Our Mission

We are the leading digital payment processing service and solution house in Asia-Pacific, strive to
provide fully integrated and comprehensive digital payment processing services for businesses,
charities, and associations as well as payment solutions which blend the latest technologies for the
financial / banking industries.



## Corporate Members

We are proud to be corporate members of the following associations.

[ [Association of Small Medium Enterprise (ASME)]][18]
[ [Australian FinTech Pty Ltd.]][19]
[ [EMVCO ]][20]
[ [FinTech Australia]][21]
[[Hong Kong Institute of Marketing (HKIM) 香港市務學會]][22]

[[MRCA Malaysia ]][25]
[[PCI Security Standards Council Associate Participating Organization program]][26]
[[SGTech]][27]
[[Thai Hotels association]][28]
[[Women in Payments]][29]

To know more about our services and let us know how we can help.

[feature]

**Power your fintech with confidence**
A modular BaaS platform for cards, payments, FX, VBAs, and RegTech — built to launch fast and scale
with support from industry experts.

[Book a demo][9]
[feature]

Bano

**Simplify global operations with one account**

**All-in-one money magic**
Split, send, save, and spend — financial tools made social, fun, and mobile-first.

Everything you need to embed localised, compliant, and global-ready financial services — all backed
by industry-grade infrastructure and deep regional expertise.

Card issuing
Card acquiring
Compliance & RegTech
Multi-currency virtual account
Savings accounts

#### Power branded cards with confidence

Launch prepaid, debit, or virtual cards — fast. Ideal for fintech, Web3 wallets, and loyalty
platforms looking for custom spend control and fraud protection.

[Card issuing]

## Smarter accounts for smarter business

Whether you're managing business expenses or client funds, Bano Business gives you fast, compliant
AUF accounts with local and global payment rails built in.

BANO BUSINESS ACCOUNT

### Virtual business account

#### Includes:
* NPP, Direct Entry, PayID
* SWIFT inbound payments
* Suited for domestic and cross-border business ops
* Multi-currency account & FX

#### Ideal for:
* Companies managing payroll, recurring expenses, and supplier invoices.

[Apply now ][11]

BANO BUSINESS ACCOUNT

### Corporate card service

#### Includes:
* **Multi-currency ready** — pay and get paid globally in multiple currencies.
* **Low FX fees** — keep more of your money when moving across borders.
* ** No hidden costs** — no account-keeping or admin fees, ever.
* **Expense and employee cards** — issue cards to your team for easy spend management.
* **Smarter control** — track, manage, and reconcile business expenses in real time.

#### Ideal for:
* SMEs, corporates, and global teams managing multi-currency payments and expenses.

[Apply now ][12]

## Introducing the Bolt Super App

Powerful, fast and smart tools to manage your money, home and abroad.

[[Request and track. Request payments effortlessly and track progress in real-time. Split bills,
collect funds, or manage expenses with ease.]][13]
[[A Minion in your wallet. We have partnered with Universal Studios to bring you cards from Minions,
Jurassic World, Trolls, Kung Fu Panda, and more.]][14]
[[Group payments made easy, Request payments effortlessly and track progress in real-time. Split
bills, collect funds, or manage expenses with ease.]][15]
[[Send and spend at great rates. No hidden costs, just smarter currency exchange. With 34
currencies, we’ve got you covered wherever you roam.]][16]
[[Simple, flexible bill splitting. Split bills effortlessly for any group or event. Share costs,
track who’s paid, and settle up with ease.]][17]

# Built Locally.
# Trusted Globally.

Operating in Australia, New Zealand, and Hong Kong, Bolt meets the highest standards of trust and
security.

We’re **SOC 1 & 2**, **ISO 27001**, and **PCI DSS** compliant — and a **principal member of
Mastercard and UnionPay**.

# Accelerating global money movement.

Enterprise-grade payments infrastructure for stablecoins.

[
Speak to an expert

##### **NEW Report**

### Build your stablecoin wallets strategy

The 2026 guide for enterprises →
[
][109]
**PRODUCT**

## Flexible models for every stage of your stablecoin journey.

Launch with BVNK's turnkey solution, or manage payments in-house with Layer1.

## Managed payments

Launch using BVNK’s [licensing][110], custody and compliance-first approach.
Use cases
Delivery models
Send
Pay contractors, suppliers and partners globally in stablecoins or fiat.
Receive
Accept stablecoin payments with minimal code – auto-convert to fiat.
Convert
Move between currencies and on/off-ramp in one platform.
Store
Hold funds in stablecoin-linked wallets with access to ACH, SEPA, Fedwire, Swift.
[Learn more][111]
EMBEDDED
Launch stablecoin products for your customers.
You control the user experience, BVNK handles compliance, onboarding and payment execution behind
the scenes.
[Learn about Embedded Wallets][112]
Direct
Use stablecoin payments for your own business needs.
Send, receive and convert funds using BVNK’s infrastructure. Bring your own licence or [use
ours][113].
[Learn more][114]

## Self-managed payments

Plug in your own licences, custodian and liquidity partners.
LAYER1
Run your own stablecoin payments network in-house.
Deploy Layer1 and connect your own licences, custodian and liquidity partners, or use BVNK where it
fits.
[Learn more][115]

## Manage payments.

Utilize BVNK's licensing, [custody][116] and [fiat safeguarding ][117]to get started.

### Virtual accounts

Send and receive payments using local and international rails.

### Accept payments

Accept payments in stablecoins in a few lines of code.

### Send payments

Pay individuals, suppliers and partners globally in stablecoins or fiat.

### Make instant transfers

Transfer funds 24/7 within the BVNK ecosystem.

[
Learn more
][118]

### Embedded wallets

NEW

In your platform, in your brand. Enable customers globally to send, receive, hold and convert
between fiat and stablecoins.

[
Learn more
][119]

### Payment orchestration

Automate and manage fiat and stablecoin transactions in-house. Leverage BVNK’s Layer1 infrastructure
for custody, payments and liquidity.

[
Learn more
][120]

## Launch stablecoin products.

A full-stack toolkit for stablecoin payments that puts you in control.
[A quote icon]

“Our stablecoin payout service allows clients across all Worldpay's verticals – such as
marketplaces, travel, and gaming – to make streamlined payouts without handling digital assets
themselves. We are delighted to work with BVNK to bring this enterprise-grade stablecoin payout
solution to market.”

John McNaught
Head of Payouts at Worldpay
[
][121]

“dLocal is constantly exploring ways to expand access and improve settlement times for our clients.
By integrating BVNK’s stablecoin capabilities, we can offer even faster, borderless payments -
without compromising compliance or control.”

John O’Brien,
CRO, dLocal

][122]

“We’re delighted to give global workers the option to get paid in stablecoins, ensuring prompt
payment. Since launching with BVNK, we’ve seen freelancers opting to be paid in stablecoins in more
than 100 countries.”

Ryan Freeman,
Head of Partnerships, Deel

][130]

## Why businesses choose BVNK.

[

### Enterprise grade

Benefit from 99.9% platform uptime and proven technology. BVNK is ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II
certified, and independently audited.
][131]

### Internationally licensed

BVNK has 25+ [licenses and regulatory approvals][132], so you can grow with confidence.
[

### Bridging financial worlds

Operate across fiat and blockchain payments, ensuring regulatory clarity.
][133]

### Flexible

Whether you're new to stablecoins or scaling operations, we’ve got you covered.

### Safeguarded

100% of customer e-money funds are segregated and protected from insolvency in line with regulatory
requirements.
[

### Compliance first

Our controls reduce counterparty risk, while our multilayered AML systems fight financial crime.
][134]

## Frequently asked questions.

How is BVNK licensed?

In the UK, BVNK operates as an Electronic Money Institution via System Pay Services Limited (company
number 11621763, authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority – Ref: 901057). Please
note that cryptoassets are not regulated in the UK by the FCA. In Europe, BVNK holds an EMI license
and multiple VASP registrations. In the US, our Delaware-incorporated entity operates under the name
System Pay Services (US), Inc. or BVNK, where permitted. System Pay Services (US), Inc. holds Money
Transmitter Licenses in several states across the US, and is registered with FinCEN as a Money
Services Business. Note that System Pay Services (US), Inc. d/b/a BVNK is not a bank and does not
provide banking services in the US. We’re committed to expanding our licensing footprint globally.
Learn more about our licenses [here][135].

How much does BVNK’s platform cost?

We charge fees to merchants for using our services and our pricing tiers are based on payment
volumes. Our aim is to operate with fair and transparent margins and to help you succeed
financially. Please get in touch with our team to receive a bespoke pricing proposal.

## Frequently asked questions.

How is BVNK licensed?

In the UK, BVNK operates as an Electronic Money Institution via System Pay Services Limited (company
number 11621763, authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority – Ref: 901057). Please
note that cryptoassets are not regulated in the UK by the FCA. In Europe, BVNK holds an EMI license
and multiple VASP registrations. In the US, our Delaware-incorporated entity operates under the name
System Pay Services (US), Inc. or BVNK, where permitted. System Pay Services (US), Inc. holds Money
Transmitter Licenses in several states across the US, and is registered with FinCEN as a Money
Services Business. Note that System Pay Services (US), Inc. d/b/a BVNK is not a bank and does not
provide banking services in the US. We’re committed to expanding our licensing footprint globally.
Learn more about our licenses [here][135].

How much does BVNK’s platform cost?

We charge fees to merchants for using our services and our pricing tiers are based on payment
volumes. Our aim is to operate with fair and transparent margins and to help you succeed
financially. Please get in touch with our team to receive a bespoke pricing proposal.

## Instantly issue virtual and physical corporate cards with built-in controls

No more out-of-policy expenses. No more waiting to be reimbursed. Just corporate cards that keep
spending in check.

[inDinero logo]

## Pay in a safe, fast way using Emburse Cards with Apple Pay.

Enjoy all the benefits of Emburse Cards using Apple Pay. It’s the easy, secure and, private way to
pay.

Features

## Features that make a difference

Each Emburse solution delivers on the promise to simplify and streamline payment and purchasing,
thanks to user-friendly features that include:

[Virtual cards]

Virtual and physical cards with spending rules

[Mobile receipts]

Mobile receipt capture and reminders

[Roles]

Role-based permissions and approval flows

[Categorization]

Automatic expense categorizations

[Fraud protection]

World-class fraud protection

[Insights]

Real-time insights and reports

[Funding]

Instantaneous funding requests and approval

[Emburse Cards on the go]

## Corporate cards made for expense management

Each Emburse Card arrives pre­loaded with gran­u­lar spend­ing rules that mir­ror your poli­cies and let
you con­trol every pur­chase. Through direct inte­gra­tion, trans­ac­tions auto­mat­i­cal­ly link to a
card­hold­er pro­file from the point of sale to expense report.

[get the guide][38]


## Solutions for every part of the organization

Expand corporate card access and reduce reimbursements, gain visibility, and auto-sync transactions
in real-time.

### Finance teams

Broaden access to approved payment methods without sacrificing control or visibility.

### IT and procurement teams

Instantly issue virtual cards with proactive controls for software, subscriptions, and other
critical purchases.

### Human resources

Remove the reimbursement burden from potential recruits for travel booking, and send them a virtual
card with a pre-set budget.

### Employees

Reduce out-of-pocket reimbursements with easy-to-use virtual and physical corporate cards.

[Emburse Cards app]

Partnerships

## Partnerships to enhance your experience

Work with the right technology and financial institution partners for you.

[

software.

# Free Credit Card Checker and Validator | chkr.cc
* [ Live0 ][15]
* [ Die0 ][16]
* [ Unknown0 ][17]

Features

## How it Works?

#### Date Check

Compare the credit card expired date with today to see the card expired or not.

#### Number Check

A Luhn Algorithm checker tool will check your card number against the Luhn Algorithm for validating.

#### BIN/IIN Check

We will look up your card bin in our database which contains more than 300,000 bin records

#### Security Check

Verify CVV and other security features to ensure the card meets standard security requirements.

#### Geographic Info

Provide detailed information about the card's issuing country, including currency and location data.

#### Bank Details

Retrieve comprehensive information about the issuing bank and card brand specifications.

Developers

## API Documentation

### Integrate Anywhere

Build our powerful BIN checking and card validation engine directly into your applications. We
provide a blazing fast, robust RESTful JSON API.

For high-volume production use, please see our [RapidAPI Commercial Plan][18].

##### Response Codes

Code 1 Live (Success)
Code 0 Die (Failed)
Code 2 Unknown
POST

#### https://api.chkr.cc/

Request.json

`{
  "data": "4242424242424242|12|2025|123"
}`

Response.json

`{
  "code": 1,
  "status": "Live",
  "message": "Approved",
  "card": {
    "card": "4242424242424242|12|2030|123",
    "bank": "JPMORGAN CHASE BANK",
    "type": "visa",
    "category": "credit",
    "country": {
      "name": "United States",
      "emoji": "🇺🇸"
    }
  }
}`

Ecosystem

## AI Capabilities

### AI Validation Agent & MCP

Our intelligent validation agent and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server are currently in the
workshop. Soon, you will be able to integrate CHKR.CC directly into your advanced AI workflows.

Coming Soon

- Modernized frontend stack to Astro.
- Prepared internal logic for AI Tool/MCP integrations.
- Performance improvements (Zero jQuery, Lighthouse optimization).

- minor bug fixes.

- MM|YY format now supported by both web app and API.
- Update API documentation.
- Update support system.
- BIN database update.
- Fixed a bug in the geographic location data.

- Gateway update.

qualified audiences.

brand.

and funding model, with standardized reporting and governance built for enterprise scale.

### Designed for stakeholder alignment

HR, procurement, and brand owners can enforce control without blocking business execution.

[ Talk to us ][35]

### Operational reliability

Enterprise fulfillment patterns that support large organizations and multi-location deployments.

[ View Pricing ][36]

### Integration-ready platform

API-first posture so your ordering and governance layer can fit your enterprise environment.

[ See integrations ][37]

## Frequently Asked Questions

Quick answers for enterprise teams evaluating governance, integration, and deployment readiness with
CCA.

How does CCA enforce business card governance?

CCA applies role-based permissions, approval routing, template controls, and policy enforcement
directly in the ordering workflow. Every order passes through configurable governance rules before
reaching production, ensuring brand consistency and compliance at scale.

Can CCA integrate with HR, CRM, ERP, and procurement systems?

CCA is integration-ready by design and supports deployment across HCM, HRIS, CRM, ERP, procurement,
SSO, and API environments. The platform's unified API backbone enables bidirectional data flow with
enterprise systems including Workday, SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, and custom proprietary platforms.

Does CCA support multi-location and multi-brand control?

CCA supports centralized governance with local execution so organizations can manage multiple
brands, entities, and regions with consistent policy controls. Each location or division can operate
within its own template, approval, and funding rules while corporate maintains oversight and audit
visibility.

What reporting and audit visibility is available?

CCA provides audit-ready visibility for procurement, HR, and operations across ordering, spend,
approvals, and policy-level activity. Reports include order history by department and location,
spend tracking by cost center, approval chain audit logs, and policy compliance summaries.

How can teams request pricing and implementation guidance?

Teams can use the Request Pricing form and briefing calls to map governance requirements,
integration paths, and enterprise deployment models. CCA's implementation team works with
stakeholders across HR, procurement, marketing, and IT to design a deployment architecture aligned
to your organizational structure.

What is the typical enterprise deployment timeline for CCA?

Deployment timelines vary based on integration complexity and organizational scope. Standalone
deployments can launch within days. Integrated enterprise deployments involving HCM, SSO, and
procurement system connections typically complete within 2–6 weeks, including template setup, role
configuration, and approval workflow mapping.

How does CCA handle sponsored business card distribution?

CCA supports sponsored distribution through its BusinessCardJunction.com engine, which manages
eligibility logic, program rules, funding allocation, and value exchange models for qualified
audiences. Organizations can sponsor cards for partners, franchisees, or field teams with full
governance and reporting.

## Request an enterprise briefing.

Discuss governance architecture, distribution models, integration pathways, and deployment options —
tailored to your environment.

### Priorities guiding our path forward

We’re putting style, design and value at the center of everything we do. And four clear priorities
are guiding strategic choices aimed at delighting guests and driving profitable growth in 2026 and
beyond.

[ Learn more ][179]
[The exterior of a Target store with large glass windows.]

We're here to help all families discover the joy of everyday life.

Since 1962, Target has been a leader in style and design, bringing our only-at-Target assortment and
guest experience to more than 2,000 communities coast to coast.

[Go to About][180]

From stores to supply chain facilities, we’re looking for new team members like you.

An equitable & regenerative future.

Our vision is to co-create an equitable and regenerative future together with our guests, partners
and communities. We call our sustainability strategy Target Forward.

## Know what's happening in real time

Distill continuously monitors news coverage, press releases, company blogs, and LinkedIn posts — so
you don't have to check dozens of sources manually.

## Only see the updates worth your attention

Distill filters out duplicate coverage, low-signal updates, and irrelevant noise, helping you
quickly spot the developments that actually matter.

Microsoft grows market share

Enterprise share continues rising

[OpenAI icon]

OpenAI releases new AI model

Reasoning and multimodality improved

[Stripe icon]

Stripe closes Bridge acquisition

Expands stablecoin infrastructure

## Get alerts where your team already works

Receive instant alerts in Slack or Microsoft Teams, read weekly email briefings, or browse
everything in Distill's live feed.

Start tracking your market today

Set up your watchlist in minutes. Start monitoring the companies that matter to you.

[Start for free ][6]

## Frequently asked questions

Which companies can I track with Distill?

You can track **any company, globally**, regardless of whether they are public or private. Unlike
traditional finance tools that rely on stock ticker symbols, Distill allows you to track early-stage
startups, private companies, and niche international players just as easily as Fortune 500
companies. If the company exists and has a website, Distill can track it.

What sources does Distill track?

Distill provides a complete picture by combining **media coverage** with **official company
sources**. We monitor:
* **Major media outlets** and trusted industry news sites.
* **Local and regional news publications**.
* **Official company channels**, including press releases, blogs, and investor relations pages.
* **Medium and Substack feeds**.
* **LinkedIn company posts** to catch product launches and leadership updates often missed by the
  press.

How is Distill different from Google Alerts?

Google Alerts provides a raw list of links, often resulting in cluttered inboxes and repetitive
headlines. Distill is an **intelligence engine**. It uses AI to:
* **Group sources**: If a story is covered by 20 outlets, we group them into a single card so you
  don't read the same headline 20 times.
* **Summarize insights**: We extract the key facts from both the media coverage and the official
  announcement.
* **Filter noise**: We automatically filter out low-value opinion pieces and duplicates.

Does Distill support international or non-English news?

Yes. You can track **companies in any country**. If a story breaks in a local language (e.g.,
Japanese, Swedish, or Portuguese), Distill automatically translates the article and summary into
English. This allows you to track global competitors or international markets without a language
barrier.

How does Distill prevent information overload?

We know that "more news" isn't always better. Distill gives you three layers of control to keep your
feed clean:
* **Significance filters**: You can toggle your feed to show "All News," "Notable News," or only
  "Major News" (high-impact events).
* **Topic filters**: You can set specific monitors for topics like "M&A," "Product launches," or
  "Executive changes" while ignoring the rest.
* **Source blocking**: If you dislike a specific publication, you can block it entirely from your
  feed and summaries.

Can I track an entire industry without selecting individual companies?

Yes. In addition to tracking specific company watchlists, you can follow broad **industry groups**
(e.g., Fintech, Artificial Intelligence, Renewable Energy). You can receive weekly emails
summarizing the biggest events from that industry.

How will I receive updates? Do I need to log in daily?

You do not need to log in to stay informed. Distill delivers insights where you already work:
* **Daily recaps**: Emails listing all the latest news from the companies you track.
* **Weekly summaries**: Emails summarizing the biggest events from the past week from the companies
  and sectors you follow.
* **Real-time alerts**: For critical updates on high-priority companies.
* **Integrations**: Get real-time updates from the companies you follow directly in Slack or
  Microsoft Teams.

Can I use Distill to track my competitors' social media activity?

Yes. Distill specifically monitors **LinkedIn company posts**. Companies often share their fastest
updates on LinkedIn before a press release goes out, such as new hires, minor product updates, or
partnerships. Distill captures these and presents them alongside traditional news.

Does Distill offer a free trial?

Yes. Distill offers a [14-day free trial][7] so you can set up your watchlists, configure your
filters, and see the difference between a standard news feed and a curated intelligence feed. Just
add the companies you want to track, and you're up and running in minutes.

## Know what's happening in real time

Distill continuously monitors news coverage, press releases, company blogs, and LinkedIn posts — so
you don't have to check dozens of sources manually.

## Only see the updates worth your attention

Distill filters out duplicate coverage, low-signal updates, and irrelevant noise, helping you
quickly spot the developments that actually matter.

[OpenAI icon]

OpenAI releases new AI model

## Get alerts where your team already works

Receive instant alerts in Slack or Microsoft Teams, read weekly email briefings, or browse
everything in Distill's live feed.

Start tracking your market today

Set up your watchlist in minutes. Start monitoring the companies that matter to you.

[Start for free ][6]

## Frequently asked questions

Which companies can I track with Distill?

You can track **any company, globally**, regardless of whether they are public or private. Unlike
traditional finance tools that rely on stock ticker symbols, Distill allows you to track early-stage
startups, private companies, and niche international players just as easily as Fortune 500
companies. If the company exists and has a website, Distill can track it.

What sources does Distill track?

Distill provides a complete picture by combining **media coverage** with **official company
sources**. We monitor:
* **Major media outlets** and trusted industry news sites.
* **Local and regional news publications**.
* **Official company channels**, including press releases, blogs, and investor relations pages.
* **Medium and Substack feeds**.
* **LinkedIn company posts** to catch product launches and leadership updates often missed by the
  press.

How is Distill different from Google Alerts?

Google Alerts provides a raw list of links, often resulting in cluttered inboxes and repetitive
headlines. Distill is an **intelligence engine**. It uses AI to:
* **Group sources**: If a story is covered by 20 outlets, we group them into a single card so you
  don't read the same headline 20 times.
* **Summarize insights**: We extract the key facts from both the media coverage and the official
  announcement.
* **Filter noise**: We automatically filter out low-value opinion pieces and duplicates.

Does Distill support international or non-English news?

Yes. You can track **companies in any country**. If a story breaks in a local language (e.g.,
Japanese, Swedish, or Portuguese), Distill automatically translates the article and summary into
English. This allows you to track global competitors or international markets without a language
barrier.

How does Distill prevent information overload?

We know that "more news" isn't always better. Distill gives you three layers of control to keep your
feed clean:
* **Significance filters**: You can toggle your feed to show "All News," "Notable News," or only
  "Major News" (high-impact events).
* **Topic filters**: You can set specific monitors for topics like "M&A," "Product launches," or
  "Executive changes" while ignoring the rest.
* **Source blocking**: If you dislike a specific publication, you can block it entirely from your
  feed and summaries.

Can I track an entire industry without selecting individual companies?

Yes. In addition to tracking specific company watchlists, you can follow broad **industry groups**
(e.g., Fintech, Artificial Intelligence, Renewable Energy). You can receive weekly emails
summarizing the biggest events from that industry.

How will I receive updates? Do I need to log in daily?

You do not need to log in to stay informed. Distill delivers insights where you already work:
* **Daily recaps**: Emails listing all the latest news from the companies you track.
* **Weekly summaries**: Emails summarizing the biggest events from the past week from the companies
  and sectors you follow.
* **Real-time alerts**: For critical updates on high-priority companies.
* **Integrations**: Get real-time updates from the companies you follow directly in Slack or
  Microsoft Teams.

Can I use Distill to track my competitors' social media activity?

Yes. Distill specifically monitors **LinkedIn company posts**. Companies often share their fastest
updates on LinkedIn before a press release goes out, such as new hires, minor product updates, or
partnerships. Distill captures these and presents them alongside traditional news.

Does Distill offer a free trial?

Yes. Distill offers a [14-day free trial][7] so you can set up your watchlists, configure your
filters, and see the difference between a standard news feed and a curated intelligence feed. Just
add the companies you want to track, and you're up and running in minutes.

## **Top Coolest Headquarters in the World**

Discover the top coolest headquarters and corporate offices in the world—iconic workplaces known for
innovative design, creative architecture, and inspiring office environments. These world-class
company headquarters set new standards for modern corporate office culture, blending functionality
with bold aesthetics to create spaces that employees genuinely enjoy working in every day.

From cutting-edge technology campuses to architecturally stunning corporate offices, these
headquarters showcase how thoughtful design, open collaboration spaces, and employee-focused
amenities can transform the workplace experience. Each headquarters highlights unique approaches to
office layout, sustainability, wellness, and creativity, making them a powerful source of
inspiration for corporate office management teams and business leaders worldwide.

To explore these incredible headquarters in action and see what makes them stand out, watch the
video below for a visual tour of some of the coolest corporate offices in the world:

If you have ever wondered what it would be like to work in a truly inspiring corporate environment,
these headquarters represent the ultimate vision of modern office life. They are not just
offices—they are destinations that reflect company culture, innovation, and forward-thinking
leadership, and they continue to influence how organizations design and manage their headquarters
across the globe.

## **What can you find in a company headquarters?**

In a company headquarters, you will typically find the organization’s leadership team along with its
most critical business functions. These departments and offices work together to manage strategy,
operations, and long-term growth:
* **Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Office** – Responsible for overall vision, leadership, and
  strategic decision-making.
* **Executive Team & Board of Directors** – Oversees corporate governance, policy direction, and
  high-level business objectives.
* **Administration Office** – Handles internal coordination, office management, and organizational
  support functions.
* **Finance, Accounting & Billing Department** – Manages budgets, financial reporting, payroll,
  billing, and compliance.
* **Marketing & Communications Department** – Develops branding, public relations, advertising, and
  internal and external communications.
* **Sales Department** – Drives revenue generation, client acquisition, and business development
  efforts.
* **Customer Service & Support** – Provides assistance to customers, manages inquiries, and resolves
  issues.
* **Research & Development Department** – Focuses on innovation, product development, and improving
  existing services or technologies.
* **Operations & Logistics** – Oversees daily business operations, supply chains, and operational
  efficiency.
* **Human Resources Department** – Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, training, and
  workplace policies.
* **Legal Department** – Handles contracts, regulatory compliance, risk management, and legal
  matters affecting the company.

Together, these offices form the operational and strategic core of a company, making the
headquarters the central hub for leadership, planning, and decision-making.

## OpenCorporates was born out of the same frustrations you experience every day

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

Since 2010 we’ve been working with government agencies, NGOs and public-benefit groups to improve
the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

# Payment Processing Company Reviews

[VIEW OUR TOP PICKS][6]

##### Welcome to PaymentProcessing.com

PaymentProcessing.com was created to enlighten and inform business owners about the best options for
their credit card processing needs. Obtaining a merchant account for your new or existing business
can be challenging in today’s marketplace, due to the vast number of companies offering payment
processing services.

In addition, there are a lot of different factors that may significantly impact your payment
processing experience, which is why our goal is to educate our visitors about the various elements
that are primary to any business desiring to accept credit cards from their customers.

The first consideration essential to a supportive merchant account is the rate structure offered by
the particular processor. There are a number of different pricing models available and it is very
important to have a clear understanding of the fee structures presented and how they compare to
other rate plans.

Additionally, a business should procure a payment processing solution that effectively and
seamlessly processes your customers’ payments in the easiest manner possible.

The next component that any company should look for, when searching for a merchant account, is the
level of customer service and support received from their processor.

Further, in order to save time, money and avoid headaches down the road, it is very important that
business owners find out about set-up times, up-front costs and any contract term that may be
required.

The entire process of setting up a merchant account can be overwhelming if you don’t know what to
look for and where to begin. We try our best to provide accurate information to help merchants
select the best payment processor for their business.

##### How Merchant Processing Works, Simplified

When a customer pays with a credit card, which was issued to them by a bank, otherwise known as an
Issuing Bank, the credit card information is collected and bundled up by the terminal or processing
solution that is being utilized by the business/merchant.

The credit card information is then transmitted through the Visa U.S.A. or MasterCard network, which
relays the customer’s card data to the Issuing Bank. The Issuing Bank will then approve or deny the
transaction based on the customer’s amount of available funds or credit. This part of the process is
often called the authorization segment.

If the transaction is approved, notification of the approval is relayed by the Issuing Bank back to
the terminal or processing solution and to whichever bank has partnered with the processor, that was
selected by the business owner to handle their merchant account. This bank is known as the Acquiring
Bank and is responsible for funding the business owner the amount of the card transaction, minus the
applicable rates and fees.

As well, the Acquiring Bank sends a payment request to the Issuing Bank for the approximate amount
of money it just funded the merchant. The Issuing Bank then funds the Acquiring Bank the requested
sum, whereupon the Issuing Bank will then collect the amount of the original charge from its
customer, who just purchased the good or service from the merchant.

##### About Our Service*

PaymentProcessing.com helps merchants research and compare various credit card processing providers.
In order to keep this information free, we receive advertising revenue from the providers featured
on our website. [Read More][7]

  [VISIT SITE][9] [read REVIEW][10]

  [VISIT SITE][12] [read REVIEW][13]

##### what to look for?
* Waived Setup Fees
* Month-to-Month Agreements
* No Early Termination Fees
* Transparent Pricing Structures
* No Hidden Fees

that are primary to any business desiring to accept credit cards from their customers.

The first consideration essential to a supportive merchant account is the rate structure offered by
the particular processor. There are a number of different pricing models available and it is very
important to have a clear understanding of the fee structures presented and how they compare to
other rate plans.

Additionally, a business should procure a payment processing solution that effectively and
seamlessly processes your customers’ payments in the easiest manner possible.

The next component that any company should look for, when searching for a merchant account, is the
level of customer service and support received from their processor.

Further, in order to save time, money and avoid headaches down the road, it is very important that
business owners find out about set-up times, up-front costs and any contract term that may be
required.

The entire process of setting up a merchant account can be overwhelming if you don’t know what to
look for and where to begin. We try our best to provide accurate information to help merchants
select the best payment processor for their business.

When a customer pays with a credit card, which was issued to them by a bank, otherwise known as an
Issuing Bank, the credit card information is collected and bundled up by the terminal or processing
solution that is being utilized by the business/merchant.

The credit card information is then transmitted through the Visa U.S.A. or MasterCard network, which
relays the customer’s card data to the Issuing Bank. The Issuing Bank will then approve or deny the
transaction based on the customer’s amount of available funds or credit. This part of the process is
often called the authorization segment.

If the transaction is approved, notification of the approval is relayed by the Issuing Bank back to
the terminal or processing solution and to whichever bank has partnered with the processor, that was
selected by the business owner to handle their merchant account. This bank is known as the Acquiring
Bank and is responsible for funding the business owner the amount of the card transaction, minus the
applicable rates and fees.

As well, the Acquiring Bank sends a payment request to the Issuing Bank for the approximate amount
of money it just funded the merchant. The Issuing Bank then funds the Acquiring Bank the requested
sum, whereupon the Issuing Bank will then collect the amount of the original charge from its
customer, who just purchased the good or service from the merchant.

To qualify for PEX’s** Q2 2025 Acquisition Promotion**, Qualifying Customers must apply and be
approved for a PEX Credit or Prepaid Expense account (“Account”) between April 1st, 2025, and June
30th, 2025 (“Promotional Period”). To qualify, the Qualifying Customer must spend an amount greater
than or equal to $1.00 USD on eligible purchases within their first 90 days after Account
verification.
* Customers who fulfill all obligations in these terms (“Qualifying Customers”) will receive a
  monthly credit (“Rebate”) equal to 3.00% of spend made at SaaS merchants, and 2% on all purchases
  made towards paid digital media. Merchants that fall under the category of SaaS or Paid Digital
  Media are at the sole discretion of PEX and can be found here.
* Rebates are limited to a maximum of $2,000 during the Promotional Period.
* The Rebate for a calendar month will be posted to the Qualifying Customer’s Account within 30 days
  after the end of the calendar month.
* Purchases made outside of the US and non-Visa network transactions do not qualify for this
  promotion. The following transactions are not purchases and will not be eligible for a Rebate:
  items returned for credit, disputed or unauthorized purchases, fraudulent transactions, any cash
  or cash-like transactions, fees and charges.
* PEX may determine that a transaction is excluded from eligibility for earning a Rebate in our sole
  discretion at any time. In addition to any other rights of recovery we may have, we will have the
  right to offset any Rebate amount paid for an ineligible transaction against future Rebate
  payments.
* If a customer’s Account is closed for any reason or is not in good standing during the calendar
  month or subsequent month, they will not earn a Rebate. If PEX sees evidence of fraud, misuse,
  abuse, or suspicious activity, as determined by us in our sole discretion, we reserve the right to
  take action. This may include, without limitation and without prior notice, any or all of the
  following: canceling any accrued but unpaid Rebate; reversing any prior Rebate credit made; taking
  legal action to recover any Rebate made in connection with such activity, including without
  limitation to recover our monetary losses, any litigation costs and fees, and damages.
* Reimbursements or purchases submitted through PEX Reimbursements do not qualify for promotions or
  rebates.
* This promotion cannot be combined with any other offer
* PEX reserves the right to change the criteria or terminate this Rebate promotion, with or without
  written notice, at any time in our sole discretion.

To qualify for PEX’s** Q2 2025 Acquisition Promotion**, Qualifying Customers must apply and be
approved for a PEX Credit or Prepaid Expense account (“Account”) between April 1st, 2025, and June
30th, 2025 (“Promotional Period”). To qualify, the Qualifying Customer must spend an amount greater
than or equal to $1.00 USD on eligible purchases within their first 90 days after Account
verification.
* Customers who fulfill all obligations in these terms (“Qualifying Customers”) will receive a
  monthly credit (“Rebate”) equal to 3.00% of spend made at SaaS merchants, and 2% on all purchases
  made towards paid digital media. Merchants that fall under the category of SaaS or Paid Digital
  Media are at the sole discretion of PEX and can be found here.
* Rebates are limited to a maximum of $2,000 during the Promotional Period.
* The Rebate for a calendar month will be posted to the Qualifying Customer’s Account within 30 days
  after the end of the calendar month.
* Purchases made outside of the US and non-Visa network transactions do not qualify for this
  promotion. The following transactions are not purchases and will not be eligible for a Rebate:
  items returned for credit, disputed or unauthorized purchases, fraudulent transactions, any cash
  or cash-like transactions, fees and charges.
* PEX may determine that a transaction is excluded from eligibility for earning a Rebate in our sole
  discretion at any time. In addition to any other rights of recovery we may have, we will have the
  right to offset any Rebate amount paid for an ineligible transaction against future Rebate
  payments.
* If a customer’s Account is closed for any reason or is not in good standing during the calendar
  month or subsequent month, they will not earn a Rebate. If PEX sees evidence of fraud, misuse,
  abuse, or suspicious activity, as determined by us in our sole discretion, we reserve the right to
  take action. This may include, without limitation and without prior notice, any or all of the
  following: canceling any accrued but unpaid Rebate; reversing any prior Rebate credit made; taking
  legal action to recover any Rebate made in connection with such activity, including without
  limitation to recover our monetary losses, any litigation costs and fees, and damages.
* Reimbursements or purchases submitted through PEX Reimbursements do not qualify for promotions or
  rebates.
* This promotion cannot be combined with any other offer
* PEX reserves the right to change the criteria or terminate this Rebate promotion, with or without
  written notice, at any time in our sole discretion.

PEX is an all-in-one corporate card and expense management platform that helps growing businesses
automate spend management, strengthen compliance and gain real-time visibility into every dollar

system, PEX helps finance teams spend less time on manual work and more time driving the business
forward.

What types of corporate cards does PEX offer?

PEX offers physical and virtual corporate charge, prepaid and disburse cards, giving businesses the
flexibility to manage employee spending, vendor purchases and project expenses from a single
platform. Every card includes built-in spend controls and integrates seamlessly with PEX's expense
management workflows.

Why do growing businesses choose PEX?

Growing businesses choose PEX because it's built to scale with them. PEX combines flexible payment
solutions, AI-powered expense management, automated workflows and real-time spend controls in a
single platform. As your business grows, PEX helps finance teams stay ahead of increasing spend,
support more employees and locations, and scale efficiently without adding administrative overhead.

Does PEX integrate with my accounting software?

Yes. PEX integrates with leading accounting, ERP and expense management systems to automate
reconciliation and reduce manual work. Transactions, receipts and coding flow directly into your
existing financial workflows, helping your team close the books faster with greater accuracy.

# Sanchar Saathi Portal – TAFCOP, Download App & Check SIM Card Details 2026

The **[Sanchar Saathi Portal][18]** is a citizen-friendly initiative by the Department of
Telecommunications (DoT), Government of India, aimed at protecting mobile users from fraud, misuse,
and mobile theft. Through this platform, users can check how many SIM cards are linked to their
Aadhaar, verify the authenticity of their mobile devices, and even block lost or stolen phones. The
integrated system also ensures that telecom services remain transparent and accountable.

In an era of rising digital threats, identity theft, and SIM-related scams, Sanchar Saathi empowers
users to monitor and manage their telecom connections securely.

## **What Is Sanchar Saathi Portal?**

Sanchar Saathi is both a web portal and a mobile app that provides multiple services related to
mobile security and SIM verification. It combines several key modules developed by the DoT to
strengthen consumer safety:
* **CEIR (Central Equipment Identity Register) –** a database that tracks and blocks lost or stolen
  mobile phones.
* **TAFCOP (Telecom Analytics for Fraud Management and Consumer Protection)** – a platform that
  helps users check the number of active SIMs issued in their name.
* **KYM (Know Your Mobile) – **a service that allows users to verify if a mobile device is genuine
  or blacklisted.

The Sanchar Saathi Portal ([www.sancharsaathi.gov.in][27]) allows users to access these features
under a single interface, making it easy to check SIM cards, block stolen phones, and safeguard
personal data.

## **Why Sanchar Saathi Portal is in News**

Recently, the Sanchar Saathi App came into the spotlight when the Department of Telecommunications
issued new directions on 28 November 2025. According to the latest rules, all mobile phone
manufacturers and importers must pre-install the Sanchar Saathi app on every new device sold in
India.

This step aims to make security features accessible to every smartphone user and ensure that
individuals can quickly report lost devices, verify IMEI numbers, and prevent SIM misuse without
needing separate apps or websites.

## **Objectives of Sanchar Saathi Portal**

The main objectives of the Sanchar Saathi Portal are:
* To protect citizens from fake, duplicate, or tampered mobile devices
* To prevent SIM frauds and identity misuse
* To help users report lost or stolen phones easily
* To support cyber safety and block suspicious activity
* To improve transparency in the telecom sector by letting users monitor their own connections

By integrating TAFCOP Sanchar Saathi and CEIR services, the portal strengthens both consumer
awareness and network-level protection.

## **Understanding TAFCOP – Sanchar Saathi Know Your Mobile Connection**

TAFCOP Sanchar Saathi is an essential component of the Sanchar Saathi system. It enables users to
find out how many SIM cards are linked to their identity using their Aadhaar or mobile number.

Here’s how you can use the TAFCOP portal for Aadhaar card mobile number check:
1. Visit the official [**TAFCOP Portal**][28]
2. Enter your mobile number and click on Generate OTP
3. Verify the OTP received on your registered phone
4. The system will display all active SIM cards associated with your Aadhaar number
5. If you find an unknown connection, you can report or block it directly from the portal

This process, also known as Sanchar Saathi SIM Check, ensures that your telecom identity is not
misused for unauthorized activities.

## **Central Equipment Identity Register (CEIR) – Role and Functions**

The CEIR system plays a crucial role in maintaining the national IMEI database. Every mobile phone
has a unique IMEI (International Mobile Equipment Identity) number. The CEIR helps ensure that only
genuine devices operate on Indian telecom networks.

**Functions of CEIR include:**
* Blocking lost or stolen phones across all Indian networks
* Preventing the use of fake or cloned IMEI numbers
* Assisting police and security agencies in tracing stolen devices
* Allowing users to unblock recovered devices

Through CEIR, users can visit the Sanchar Saathi Portal, enter their IMEI number, and block a stolen
phone instantly. This helps reduce mobile theft and the illegal sale of blacklisted devices.

The Sanchar Saathi App, available on the Google Play Store, provides all major features of the

### **How to Download the Sanchar Saathi App**
1. Open the Play Store on your Android phone
2. Search for “[**Sanchar Saathi App**][29]”
3. Tap Install and open the app after downloading
4. Register using your mobile number and verify via OTP

* Option to report and block unknown or inactive numbers
* SMS alerts when a new SIM is issued under your identity
* A complaint tracking system to follow up on fraud reports

While the Sanchar Saathi App strengthens user safety, there are also concerns about data privacy and

**Some experts believe the app should include:**
* Clear guidelines on how long user data is stored
* Stronger encryption to prevent unauthorized access
* Transparent policies about who can view or use stored data
* Strict penalties for misuse of personal information

## **Impact of Sanchar Saathi Portal on Telecom Security**

The Sanchar Saathi TAFCOP initiative has significantly improved transparency in the telecom sector.
It allows citizens to directly control and verify their digital identity, reducing the risk of SIM
cloning, fake activations, and identity theft.

Telecom operators are also required to update their systems regularly to align with Sanchar Saathi’s
security standards. This results in better tracking of user activity, fewer spam calls, and a more
accountable network.

## **Way Forward**

Going forward, the Sanchar Saathi Portal and App can be made even more effective by:
* Expanding awareness about its features through digital literacy campaigns
* Encouraging telecom companies and phone makers to integrate it deeply into devices
* Ensuring better coordination with law enforcement for stolen phone recovery
* Introducing multilingual support for rural and regional users

## Frequently Asked Questions

Who is Tab Commerce?

Tab Commerce is a financial technology company providing the only finance platform built for
restaurants. Learn more about us [here][87].

How long does it take to get started?

We're from the restaurant industry and know time is a constrained resource. We've built our
onboarding process to get you fully up and running in 10 minutes or less.

How do Tab corporate cards work?

Tab cards work just like any other corporate card but with the benefits of powerful spend control
software built just for restaurants.

Can Tab Cards be added to Apple Wallet?

Yes, simply add the Tab Card into your Apple Wallet like you would any other card.

Where can I use Tab Cards?

Anywhere that Visa is accepted (most places). Most core vendors accept cards, but some might only be
available upon request - we can help you with that.

Can I add my team to Tab?

You can create as many users as you would like with a simple onboarding process and customized
roles.

Can I add multiple entities to Tab?

You can create as many entities as you need, and manage them all from a single login.

What are flexible payment terms?

The Tab Card gives restaurants more control and flexibility over their cash flow. Extended payment
terms allows restaurants to extend eligible re-payments on their Tab Card by 30 days, providing up
to 60 day terms. This is for eligible, pre-approved customers only. Inquire to see eligibility.

Do you offer support?

We provide near-instant support from real humans based in the US and Canada. Support can be accessed
via live chat in the platform or by emailing support@tabcommerce.com.

How can I get started?

Click the 'Get Started' button in the top right of this page. You'll receive an email to create your
account and book a time to finish onboarding with your dedicated account rep.

# Agents that own the work

The AI command center for your team's agents, connections, knowledge, and apps.

Describe a task or responsibility
Create agent
* When support@acme.com receives an email, look up the customer in Salesforce, find the answer in
  Notion, and draft a reply in Gmail.
* Build a live priorities dashboard from Slack updates, Asana projects, and Google Calendar
  milestones, showing owners, deadlines, and blockers.
* Use the Browser to download vendor invoices, match them to Ramp transactions, and record approved
  expenses in QuickBooks.
* Before every Calendly sales call, research the account in ZoomInfo, update the HubSpot
  opportunity, and prepare a tailored briefing.
* After every Fireflies meeting, create assigned follow-ups in ClickUp and email attendees a summary
  through Outlook.
* Browse leading car manufacturers' homepages and create a polished PDF report with screenshots
  comparing their messaging, featured models, and promotions, then save it to Google Drive.
[Scroll to explore][22]

How it works

## From a sentence to a completed task

No flowcharts. No setup wizards. Describe what you want in plain English — Tasklet figures out the
rest.

Built for teams

## The fastest moving teams run on Tasklet

Tasklet is the AI command center that gives superpowers to your whole team. Share agents, knowledge,
and API keys — easily and securely.

[A Piping Technology & Products team member texting a Tasklet agent from the shop floor][Piping
Technology & Products]

Customer story · Manufacturing

How 60+ employees at Piping Technology are getting hours back every day

Inside the 51-year-old Houston manufacturer where the CEO ran an “emergency onboarding” — and 40
days later, Tasklet is at work in engineering, finance, operations, and the executive office.

Watch the videoRead the case study
Close

Piping Technology & Products · Manufacturing

How 60+ employees at Piping Technology are getting hours back every day

[Read the case study][23]

### Share access, not keys

Set up a connection once, share it with the right people. They get to work; the credentials stay
locked down.

### Share agents

Build an agent once and the whole team can run it, reuse it, and make it better. No more rebuilding.
No more "can you send me the prompt?"

### Share knowledge & skills

Drop in your processes, brand, and context, so every agent works like a teammate who's been here for
years.

### Stay in control

Centralized billing, per-member limits, and clear usage — fund your team without handing out
corporate cards or bracing for the invoice.

Connections

## If it has an API, Tasklet can use it

Your agent isn't boxed into one suite. Thousands of apps are one click away. But the real unlock:
Tasklet can build connections automatically to**any** HTTP API or MCP server — including the
internal, private ones your company built itself.

Tasklet agents run in the cloud, so they work even when your laptop is closed. Set them to run on a

anywhere. Work happens, your agent notices, and it gets moving. No one has to press go.

## Give your agents a real computer

Every agent gets its own secure cloud sandbox — a full machine to run code, crunch data, process
files, and build things. Heavy work runs in isolation, not on your laptop, not in your data.

And when something only lives behind a login or a clunky web UI, your agent opens a browser and does
it the way a person would. **If a human can do it through a browser, your agent can too.**Safer,
sandboxed, and built to scale across hundreds of tasks at once.

Apps

## Need an app? Ask for it

Tasklet can turn any prompt into live software. A dashboard, a tracker, a calculator, an approval
workflow, an internal CRUD app — built on the spot, wired to your real data and tools, and sharable
with your team.

No templates. No procurement. No waiting on eng. Just the right tool for the job, ready to use
immediately.

## The best models, no matter who's winning this week

Give your team access to the frontier models from every major lab — Anthropic, OpenAI, Google — all
through one plan. Tasklet routes each job to the model that does it best: reasoning from one, image
generation from another, and transcription from a third.

## Frequently
## asked questions.

What is TechnologyChecker.io?

TechnologyChecker.io is a technology intelligence platform built for B2B sales, GTM, and market
analysis teams. We provide real-time subscriber and churn signals, 20-year historical data for ICP
analysis (recent years from our own crawls, prior years rebuilt from public web archives — see the
methodology page), and verified decision-maker contacts across 40,000+ technologies and 50M+ domains
— including backend and standalone platforms that frontend-only tools miss.

How does TechnologyChecker work?

Our platform uses multiple detection methods including HTTP header analysis, JavaScript
fingerprinting, HTML parsing, and DNS lookups to accurately identify technologies used by any
website.

What makes TechnologyChecker different from Wappalyzer?

Seven key differences: (1) Full-stack detection — we detect backend tools like n8n, databases, and
standalone platforms like Airtable that Wappalyzer can't see. (2) 40,000+ technologies vs ~8,000.
(3) Real-time subscriber & churn signals — know the moment companies adopt or drop any technology.
(4) Verified contacts included at $89/month — Wappalyzer requires their $450/month plan. (5) Company
+ contact data per technology with custom audience exports. (6) 20-year historical data for ICP
analysis and churn prediction (recent years from our own crawls, prior years rebuilt year-by-year
from public web archives like Common Crawl — methodology is published). (7) Enterprise API, bulk
enrichment, and CRM automation — not just a browser extension.

How accurate is your technology detection?

We achieve high accuracy through multi-signal detection combining headless JavaScript rendering,
HTTP header analysis, DNS/TLS fingerprinting, library signatures, and infrastructure probing. Our
system detects 40,000+ technologies including backend tools and standalone SaaS products. Every
detection includes a confidence score, and we continuously validate results across 50M+ domains.

What types of technologies can you detect?

We detect 40,000+ technologies including CMS platforms, ecommerce solutions, analytics tools,
marketing automation, CDNs, payment processors, frameworks, programming languages, and hosting
providers.

Do you have historical data?

Yes — our historical technology timelines reach back roughly 20 years. The recent ~2 years come from
our own snapshotted crawls; the prior ~18 years are rebuilt by analyzing petabytes of Common Crawl
archives (back to 2008), Internet Archive / Wayback Machine snapshots for earlier coverage, and data
from third-party archive partners. We re-run our current detection fingerprints against those
records year-by-year, so you get adoption and churn data per domain across the full timeline — not a
smoothed average. Methodology is on our /methodology page.

Do you comply with GDPR and privacy regulations?

Absolutely. We only analyze publicly accessible website data and signatures. We never access private
information and maintain full compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy regulations.

How can sales teams use TechnologyChecker.io?

Sales teams use our platform to identify prospects using specific technologies, track competitor
customers, receive alerts when companies switch tools, and access verified contact data for
outreach.

What about marketing and growth teams?

Marketing teams leverage TechnologyChecker for competitive analysis, market sizing, identifying
integration partners, tracking industry adoption trends, and building targeted prospect lists.

Where does your data come from?

Five primary channels: live web crawling with real browser rendering across 50M+ indexed domains,
passive DNS monitoring that detects infrastructure changes within 15 minutes, TLS certificate
transparency logs, historical Common Crawl archives going back to 2008, and third-party data
partners. High-traffic domains refresh every 24–72 hours. Every detection carries a confidence score
so you know exactly how reliable each signal is.

## Frequently
## asked questions.

What is TechnologyChecker.io?

TechnologyChecker.io is a technology intelligence platform built for B2B sales, GTM, and market
analysis teams. We provide real-time subscriber and churn signals, 20-year historical data for ICP
analysis (recent years from our own crawls, prior years rebuilt from public web archives — see the
methodology page), and verified decision-maker contacts across 40,000+ technologies and 50M+ domains
— including backend and standalone platforms that frontend-only tools miss.

How does TechnologyChecker work?

Our platform uses multiple detection methods including HTTP header analysis, JavaScript
fingerprinting, HTML parsing, and DNS lookups to accurately identify technologies used by any
website.

What makes TechnologyChecker different from Wappalyzer?

Seven key differences: (1) Full-stack detection — we detect backend tools like n8n, databases, and
standalone platforms like Airtable that Wappalyzer can't see. (2) 40,000+ technologies vs ~8,000.
(3) Real-time subscriber & churn signals — know the moment companies adopt or drop any technology.
(4) Verified contacts included at $89/month — Wappalyzer requires their $450/month plan. (5) Company
+ contact data per technology with custom audience exports. (6) 20-year historical data for ICP
analysis and churn prediction (recent years from our own crawls, prior years rebuilt year-by-year
from public web archives like Common Crawl — methodology is published). (7) Enterprise API, bulk
enrichment, and CRM automation — not just a browser extension.

How accurate is your technology detection?

We achieve high accuracy through multi-signal detection combining headless JavaScript rendering,
HTTP header analysis, DNS/TLS fingerprinting, library signatures, and infrastructure probing. Our
system detects 40,000+ technologies including backend tools and standalone SaaS products. Every
detection includes a confidence score, and we continuously validate results across 50M+ domains.

What types of technologies can you detect?

We detect 40,000+ technologies including CMS platforms, ecommerce solutions, analytics tools,
marketing automation, CDNs, payment processors, frameworks, programming languages, and hosting
providers.

Do you have historical data?

Yes — our historical technology timelines reach back roughly 20 years. The recent ~2 years come from
our own snapshotted crawls; the prior ~18 years are rebuilt by analyzing petabytes of Common Crawl
archives (back to 2008), Internet Archive / Wayback Machine snapshots for earlier coverage, and data
from third-party archive partners. We re-run our current detection fingerprints against those
records year-by-year, so you get adoption and churn data per domain across the full timeline — not a
smoothed average. Methodology is on our /methodology page.

Do you comply with GDPR and privacy regulations?

Absolutely. We only analyze publicly accessible website data and signatures. We never access private
information and maintain full compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy regulations.

How can sales teams use TechnologyChecker.io?

Sales teams use our platform to identify prospects using specific technologies, track competitor
customers, receive alerts when companies switch tools, and access verified contact data for
outreach.

What about marketing and growth teams?

Marketing teams leverage TechnologyChecker for competitive analysis, market sizing, identifying
integration partners, tracking industry adoption trends, and building targeted prospect lists.

Where does your data come from?

Five primary channels: live web crawling with real browser rendering across 50M+ indexed domains,
passive DNS monitoring that detects infrastructure changes within 15 minutes, TLS certificate
transparency logs, historical Common Crawl archives going back to 2008, and third-party data
partners. High-traffic domains refresh every 24–72 hours. Every detection carries a confidence score
so you know exactly how reliable each signal is.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is a Digital Business Card?

A digital business card is the creation and sharing of traditional paper-based business cards in a
digital environment. This system allows users to store their contact information and professional
details in electronic format. Digital business cards can be accessed and shared via smartphones,
tablets, and computers. They can also be quickly and conveniently sent to the other party using QR
codes or NFC technologies. This eliminates the difficulties associated with carrying, storing, and
replacing physical business cards. Digital business cards ensure that the most accurate information
is always visible to the other party, as they allow users to keep their contact information secure
and up-to-date. They can also be customized with various design and content options, allowing them
to be tailored to the brand image. Compared to traditional business cards, digital alternatives are
environmentally friendly and offer cost advantages. Content can be updated or changed at any time,
whenever needed. Therefore, there is no need to print new business cards when contact information
changes frequently or new communication channels are created. One of the key advantages of digital
business cards is the ability to reach a large number of people quickly and effectively. This
feature provides significant convenience in terms of time and cost, especially at networking events
or business meetings. Furthermore, analytical data can be obtained through digital business cards;
for example, statistics such as which person viewed or shared the card can be obtained, allowing
communication strategies to be optimized. Specifically, when integrated with NFC and QR code
technologies, they enable instant and contactless sharing. Thanks to these technologies, information
can be transferred to the other party's phone or device in just a few seconds. In short, digital
business cards are among the technological solutions that facilitate communication, reduce costs,
and align with sustainability principles in the modern business world.

How Does a Digital Business Card Work?

The working principle of digital business cards involves users storing their current contact
information in a digital environment and using various technologies to share this information. In
this system, the user or company first registers on the platform and creates their profile and
business card content. This content includes basic information such as name, title, phone number,
email address, and social media links, and visual materials such as company logos or portfolios can
also be added if desired. The created digital business card is stored on the platform and becomes
ready for various sharing methods.


Two main methods stand out in the sharing process: QR code and NFC technology. The QR code method
allows users to quickly access digital business cards. The user shows the QR code they have created
to the other party or initiates the direct flow of information with a device that scans the code. In
this method, contact information can be automatically saved to the phone by clicking on the link or
scanning the QR code. With NFC (Near Field Communication) technology, automatic data transfer occurs
when the device is brought close to the card.


Information is typically transferred via digital business cards thanks to the integrations and
technical infrastructure provided by the platform. During this process, the profile and information
created on the platform can be updated automatically or manually. Users can continue to share their
most up-to-date contact details by editing their profile information at any time. In addition,
platforms often provide access and sharing statistics. This allows the effectiveness of business
